annotations.title: Edit, copy or delete a template

description: Changes an existing message template at Meta. action edit replaces all of its components and returns it to review (an approved template can be edited once in 24 hours); copy creates it on another WhatsApp account of the same business, where Meta reviews it again; delete removes it at Meta and from Cosend once Meta confirms. It acts only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it acts. Ten changes a day per workspace. It sends no message to anyone. Meta’s reason for a refusal is in Meta’s words.

action.description: edit replaces the template’s components and sends it back to Meta’s review; copy makes a copy of it on another WhatsApp account of the business; delete removes it at Meta.

add_security_recommendation.description: Whether Meta adds "For your security, do not share this code." to the body.

button.description: Refused. WhatsApp writes the button label in each language; there is no text to set. Give delivery instead: {"type": "copy_code"}.

code_expiration_minutes.description: Minutes the code stays valid, 1 to 90: Meta's footer "This code expires in N minutes." Left out or null, there is no footer.

delivery.description: How the code reaches the person: {"type": "copy_code"}, or {"type": "one_tap" | "zero_tap", "apps": [{"package_name": "com.example.app", "signature_hash": "K8a/AINcGX7"}]} (1 to 5 apps); zero-tap also takes "zero_tap_terms_accepted": true.

apps.description: The Android apps the code is handed to: 1 to 5, Meta's supported_apps.
The Android apps the code is handed to: 1 to 5, Meta's supported_apps.

zero_tap_terms_accepted.description: Meta's zero_tap_terms_accepted: "Set to true to indicate that you understand that your use of zero-tap authentication is subject to the WhatsApp Business Terms of Service." Sent to Meta and recorded in the audit log.

languages.description: The language versions to create, e.g. ["fr", "en_US"]: one template per language, each written by WhatsApp in its language. On an edit, left out or exactly the template's own language.

message_send_ttl_seconds.description: How long WhatsApp keeps trying to deliver the message: 30 to 900 seconds, or -1 for 30 days. Left out or null, WhatsApp's default for authentication, 10 minutes.

authentication.description: An authentication template's choices, as create takes them. An edit is one language version: languages is left out, or exactly the template's own language.

category.description: A new category, sent to Meta when it differs. Meta refuses a change on an approved template, so that is refused here first.

components.description: Meta's components, all of them; required on every category but authentication, which takes authentication instead.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

display_name.description: A new human name for the copy, from which its system name is made (with _2, _3… added when the account already has that name). Without it the copy keeps the template’s names, and an account that already has a template of that name in that language is 409 template_name_taken.

example_values.description: A sample value for every variable in the TEXT header and the body, keyed per component by the name between the braces: {"body": {"1": "Pablo", "2": "860198-230332"}} or {"body": {"first_name": "Pablo"}}. Required for each such variable, because Meta rejects a template without samples; a missing one is refused with invalid_request, param example_values. Sent to Meta as each component's example. A component that already carries Meta's own example and has no entry here is sent as it is.

id.description: The template: its tpl_ id, or name:language.

language.description: The template's language. It stays the same: a different one is refused.

name.description: The template's system name. It stays the same: a different one is refused.

waba_id.description: The WhatsApp Business Account to copy to, as Cosend's wab_ id (a connection's waba_id, not its meta_waba_id). It must be another account of the same business portfolio.
